# Work_Organization<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f2f5ff" />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default" />
  <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Jade 工作台" />
  <meta name="application-name" content="Jade 工作台" />
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64," />
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64," />
  <title>Jade Bunny 工作台</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-1: #f2f5ff;
      --bg-2: #f9f1ff;
      --blue-900: #263d78;
      --blue-700: #4f70d7;
      --blue-500: #7ea6ff;
      --blue-200: #dbe7ff;
      --purple-700: #9a71df;
      --purple-300: #e6d8ff;
      --pink-300: #ffd5e8;
      --pink-500: #ff8fbd;
      --cream: #fff9ef;
      --card: rgba(255, 255, 255, .84);
      --ink: #314069;
      --muted: #7b86aa;
      --ok: #6dc9b5;
      --warn: #ffb95f;
      --danger: #ef7198;
      --shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(72, 91, 160, .20);
      --soft-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(72, 91, 160, .13);
      --radius-xl: 32px;
      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-md: 18px;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: clamp(0px, 2.2vw, 24px);
      font-family: "Trebuchet MS", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
      color: var(--ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 14%, rgba(126, 166, 255, .45), transparent 24%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 12%, rgba(230, 216, 255, .9), transparent 26%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 74% 86%, rgba(255, 213, 232, .75), transparent 26%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, var(--bg-1), var(--bg-2));
    }

    .phone-shell {
      width: min(430px, 100%);
      height: min(920px, calc(100vh - 36px));
      height: min(920px, calc(100dvh - 36px));
      min-height: min(720px, 100vh);
      min-height: min(720px, 100dvh);
      border-radius: 46px;
      padding: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff, #dfe6ff);
      box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(39, 54, 112, .28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7);
      position: relative;
      transition: width .24s ease, height .24s ease, border-radius .24s ease;
    }

    .phone-shell::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 9px;
      left: 50%;
      width: 118px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 0 0 18px 18px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: #eef3ff;
      z-index: 4;
      box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(49, 64, 105, .08);
    }

    .app {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 38px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 5%, rgba(255, 213, 232, .85), transparent 22%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #f7f9ff 0%, #f9f2ff 54%, #fff8fb 100%);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 78px 1fr;
    }

    .side-rail {
      padding: 50px 10px 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.72), rgba(230,216,255,.42));
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(126, 166, 255, .22);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      z-index: 2;
      overflow-y: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .side-rail::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .bunny-logo {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      margin: 0 auto 10px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.96) 0 20%, transparent 21%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,245,250,.98), rgba(222,232,255,.92));
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.26);
      box-shadow: inset 0 -8px 18px rgba(126,166,255,.13), var(--soft-shadow);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 12px 18px rgba(79,112,215,.16));
      font-size: 38px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .bunny-logo::before,
    .bunny-logo::after,
    .bunny-face { display: none; content: none; }

    .tab {
      width: 54px;
      min-height: 58px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--muted);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      transition: transform .18s ease, background .18s ease, color .18s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .tab:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .tab.active {
      color: var(--blue-900);
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff, #e9efff);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow), inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(79,112,215,.08);
    }

    .tab-icon { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }
    .tab-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; }
    .tab-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 5px;
      right: 4px;
      min-width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      padding: 0 5px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: var(--pink-500);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      border: 2px solid #fff;
    }

    .content {
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 52px 16px 18px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      container-type: inline-size;
    }
    .content::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      color: var(--purple-700);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 30px;
      line-height: .95;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
    }

    .sync-pill {
      border: 0;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .sync-dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--danger);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239,113,152,.18);
    }
    .sync-pill.connected .sync-dot {
      background: var(--ok);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(109,201,181,.2);
    }

    .page { display: none; animation: rise .24s ease both; }
    .page.active { display: block; }
    @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    .hero-card {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(230,216,255,.72)),
        repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 27px, rgba(126,166,255,.12) 27px 28px);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.22);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-card::after {
      content: "♡";
      position: absolute;
      right: 16px;
      top: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,143,189,.65);
      font-size: 32px;
      transform: rotate(12deg);
    }
    .date-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--blue-700);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .quote-cn { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--blue-900); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 900; }
    .quote-en { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; }

    .section-title { margin: 18px 0 10px; color: var(--blue-900); font-size: 19px; }
    .stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
    .stat-card {
      min-height: 98px;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow), inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(79,112,215,.06);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .stat-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      right: -18px;
      bottom: -20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: var(--tint, var(--blue-200));
      transform: rotate(17deg);
      opacity: .75;
    }
    .stat-label { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .stat-value { position: relative; color: var(--blue-900); font-size: 31px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; }

    .card {
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .form-grid { display: grid; gap: 9px; }
    .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; }
    input, button { font-family: inherit; }
    input {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      border: 0;
      outline: 0;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 13px 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
      color: var(--ink);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(126,166,255,.18);
    }
    .primary-btn, .soft-btn {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      min-height: 44px;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-700), var(--purple-700));
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(79,112,215,.22);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .soft-btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink-500), var(--purple-700)); }

    .countdown-list, .mini-list, .record-list, .task-list { display: grid; gap: 9px; }
    .list-item, .task-item, .record-item, .countdown-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.76);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.15);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(72, 91, 160, .08);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    .list-item strong, .task-text, .record-item strong, .countdown-item strong {
      min-width: 0;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      word-break: break-word;
    }
    .task-item.done .task-text { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: line-through wavy rgba(154,113,223,.55) 1.5px; }
    .check {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 2px solid var(--blue-500);
      background: #fff;
      color: transparent;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 900;
    }
    .task-item.done .check { background: var(--purple-700); color: #fff; transform: rotate(-5deg); }
    .delete-btn {
      border: 0;
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: #ffeaf3;
      color: var(--danger);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .calendar-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(219,231,255,.88), rgba(255,255,255,.84)); }
    .calendar-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .calendar-month { color: var(--blue-900); font-weight: 900; }
    .calendar-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
    .weekday, .day { min-height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 13px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
    .weekday { color: var(--muted); min-height: 22px; }
    .day { background: rgba(255,255,255,.72); color: var(--ink); position: relative; }
    .day.muted { opacity: .32; }
    .day.today { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-700), var(--purple-700)); transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .day.has-task::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 4px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pink-500); box-shadow: 7px 0 0 var(--warn), -7px 0 0 var(--ok); }

    .progress-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin: 10px 0 12px; }
    .progress-line { height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(126,166,255,.18); }
    .progress-line span { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: inherit; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue-500), var(--pink-500)); transition: width .2s ease; }
    .progress-text { color: var(--purple-700); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }

    .countdown-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; }
    .countdown-number { min-width: 60px; text-align: center; color: var(--blue-900); font-size: 25px; font-weight: 900; }
    .countdown-number span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 3px; }
    .empty { padding: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); border: 1px dashed rgba(126,166,255,.28); border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); }
    .empty strong { display: block; color: var(--blue-900); margin-bottom: 5px; }

    .record-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto auto; }
    .record-item > div { min-width: 0; }
    .tag { padding: 6px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--blue-200); color: var(--blue-700); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; white-space: nowrap; }
    .amount { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 900; white-space: nowrap; }
    small { color: var(--muted); }

    .draft-note {
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .health-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .health-card {
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .health-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      right: -20px;
      top: -20px;
      width: 82px;
      height: 82px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: var(--health-tint, var(--pink-300));
      transform: rotate(16deg);
      opacity: .42;
    }

    .health-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .health-card p {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .health-card .form-row,
    .health-card .form-grid {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .sleep-card {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(150px, .8fr) minmax(0, 1.7fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px 12px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 22px;
    }

    .sleep-card h3,
    .sleep-card p {
      margin: 0;
    }

    .sleep-card p {
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .sleep-form-slim {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .sleep-card .period-status {
      margin-top: 0;
      padding: 9px 11px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .period-status {
      margin-top: 10px;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 13px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .donut-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .donut {
      --segments: conic-gradient(var(--blue-200) 0 100%);
      width: 136px;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--segments);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(126,166,255,.18), var(--soft-shadow);
      position: relative;
    }

    .donut::after {
      content: "";
      width: 72px;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fff, #f3f6ff);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(126,166,255,.15);
    }

    .donut-total {
      position: absolute;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-weight: 900;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .donut-total small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .legend-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .legend-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .legend-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--dot);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--dot) 18%, transparent);
    }

    .chart-empty {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .language-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .language-card {
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .language-card::after {
      content: attr(data-mark);
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      top: 6px;
      color: rgba(154,113,223,.18);
      font-size: 54px;
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1;
      transform: rotate(8deg);
    }

    .language-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .language-card p {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .language-card form { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .language-streak {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 2px 0 12px;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(219,231,255,.78), rgba(255,213,232,.46));
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.16);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .language-streak strong {
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 20px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .language-streak span {
      color: #6a78a5;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .language-streak button {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
      color: #7a68a9;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 14px rgba(126,166,255,.12);
    }

    .language-streak button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }


    .job-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .job-note {
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.86), rgba(240,235,255,.72));
      border: 1px solid rgba(154,113,223,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .job-note::after {
      content: "JOB";
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      top: 8px;
      color: rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      font-size: 50px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      transform: rotate(7deg);
    }

    .job-note h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .job-note p {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .job-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .job-form-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .job-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .job-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.76);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.12);
    }

    .job-item strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 15px;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .job-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .job-chip {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(126,166,255,.14);
      color: #536397;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .travel-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .china-map-card {
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 15%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 14%, transparent 15%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 20%, rgba(255,189,213,.42), transparent 28%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(219,231,255,.92), rgba(248,232,255,.8));
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.22);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .map-title-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .map-title-row h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .map-title-row span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .china-map {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 260px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.42) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.42) 1px, transparent 1px),
        radial-gradient(circle at 54% 52%, rgba(255,255,255,.78), rgba(211,226,255,.66));
      background-size: 100% 25%, 12.5% 100%, 100% 100%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.2);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .province {
      position: absolute;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(135,199,185,.78), rgba(126,166,255,.58));
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.54);
      box-shadow: inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(83,99,151,.1), 0 10px 22px rgba(126,166,255,.08);
      opacity: .94;
    }

    .province.xinjiang { left: 12%; top: 22%; width: 25%; height: 28%; border-radius: 58% 42% 48% 52%; transform: rotate(-12deg); }
    .province.northwest { left: 32%; top: 32%; width: 22%; height: 26%; border-radius: 48% 55% 52% 48%; transform: rotate(7deg); }
    .province.tibet { left: 21%; top: 55%; width: 32%; height: 24%; border-radius: 54% 46% 58% 42%; transform: rotate(4deg); }
    .province.north { left: 48%; top: 25%; width: 23%; height: 22%; border-radius: 47% 53% 42% 58%; transform: rotate(-5deg); }
    .province.central { left: 50%; top: 45%; width: 25%; height: 23%; border-radius: 48% 52% 58% 44%; transform: rotate(5deg); }
    .province.east { left: 68%; top: 39%; width: 16%; height: 25%; border-radius: 42% 58% 46% 54%; transform: rotate(9deg); }
    .province.south { left: 57%; top: 63%; width: 24%; height: 17%; border-radius: 55% 45% 50% 48%; transform: rotate(-4deg); }
    .province.northeast { left: 67%; top: 16%; width: 17%; height: 22%; border-radius: 52% 48% 56% 44%; transform: rotate(16deg); }
    .province.southwest { left: 43%; top: 61%; width: 19%; height: 22%; border-radius: 50% 45% 54% 46%; transform: rotate(-12deg); }
    .province.hainan { left: 68%; top: 84%; width: 6%; height: 5%; border-radius: 58% 42% 50% 48%; }
    .province.taiwan { left: 84%; top: 63%; width: 4%; height: 12%; border-radius: 50% 50% 54% 46%; transform: rotate(18deg); }

    .china-map-label {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      padding: 4px 7px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.66);
      color: rgba(83,99,151,.72);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.16);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .label-west { left: 25%; top: 38%; }
    .label-north { left: 56%; top: 31%; }
    .label-east { left: 72%; top: 51%; }
    .label-south { left: 62%; top: 70%; }

    .china-map.detailed {
      min-height: 310px;
    }

    .china-svg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 7% 3% 5% 3%;
      width: 94%;
      height: 88%;
      overflow: visible;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 22px rgba(83,99,151,.12));
    }

    .province-layer text {
      fill: rgba(83,99,151,.72);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .cn-area.big {
      fill: rgba(255,255,255,.42);
      stroke: rgba(126,166,255,.22);
      stroke-width: 3;
    }

    .cn-province, .cn-island {
      fill: url(#provinceFill);
      stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.74);
      stroke-width: 3;
      vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
      transition: transform .22s ease, filter .22s ease;
    }

    .cn-province.alt, .cn-island.alt { fill: url(#provinceFillAlt); }

    .cn-province:hover, .cn-island:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.05);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .mini-city {
      fill: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
      stroke: rgba(235,104,145,.52);
      stroke-width: 3;
    }

    .mini-label {
      fill: #536397;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .map-pin {
      position: absolute;
      left: var(--x);
      top: var(--y);
      transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: default;
      z-index: 3;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 8px rgba(83,99,151,.22));
    }

    .map-pin::before {
      content: "";
      display: block;
      width: 15px;
      height: 15px;
      border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink-500), var(--purple-300));
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    }

    .map-pin span {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      top: -28px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.2);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .map-pin:hover span { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px); }

    .travel-form-card, .wishlist-card {
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
    }

    .travel-form-card h3, .wishlist-card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .travel-form-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto;
    }

    .travel-helper {
      margin: 9px 2px 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .wishlist-form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .travel-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 23px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.76);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.1);
    }

    .travel-item strong {
      color: var(--blue-900);
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .travel-item small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 800; }

    .reading-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .reading-card {
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 9% 12%, rgba(255,255,255,.95) 0 12%, transparent 13%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,245,250,.9), rgba(225,234,255,.82));
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.2);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .reading-card::after {
      content: "READ";
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      top: 8px;
      color: rgba(154,113,223,.14);
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      transform: rotate(7deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .reading-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .reading-head h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .reading-head span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .reading-form {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      grid-template-columns: .75fr 1.35fr .9fr 1.2fr auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .reading-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .reading-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 14px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.78);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.1);
    }

    .reading-item strong {
      color: var(--blue-900);
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .reading-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 7px;
    }

    .reading-chip {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255,189,213,.18);
      color: #69749d;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ai-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .ai-memo-card {
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 14%, rgba(255,255,255,.96) 0 12%, transparent 13%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 86% 18%, rgba(255,213,232,.62), transparent 30%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(225,235,255,.94), rgba(246,232,255,.84));
      border: 1px solid rgba(154,113,223,.20);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ai-memo-card::after {
      content: "MEMO";
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      top: 8px;
      color: rgba(126,166,255,.16);
      font-size: 50px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      transform: rotate(7deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .ai-memo-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ai-memo-head h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .ai-memo-head span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ai-memo-form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .68fr 1.45fr auto auto;
      gap: 8px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ai-memo-helper {
      margin: 9px 2px 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.45;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .ai-memo-pockets {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .ai-pocket {
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.72);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(154,113,223,.26);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.1);
    }

    .ai-pocket strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .ai-pocket small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .ai-memo-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .ai-memo-group {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.14);
    }

    .ai-memo-group h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .ai-memo-item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.80);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.10);
    }

    .ai-memo-item strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .ai-memo-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 7px;
    }

    .ai-memo-chip {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(219,231,255,.72);
      color: #5f6f9f;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .ai-memo-chip.project {
      background: rgba(255,213,232,.56);
      color: #8a5f86;
    }


    .news-panel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-card {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.94) 0 11%, transparent 12%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 92% 12%, rgba(255,213,232,.70), transparent 28%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(230,241,255,.94), rgba(247,234,255,.88));
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.22);
      box-shadow: var(--soft-shadow);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-card::after {
      content: "NEWS";
      position: absolute;
      right: 10px;
      top: 4px;
      color: rgba(154,113,223,.13);
      font-size: 54px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -3px;
      transform: rotate(6deg);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .news-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: start;
      gap: 10px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .news-head h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .news-head p {
      margin: 6px 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .news-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .news-source-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .news-source-card {
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.75);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(126,166,255,.24);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.10);
    }

    .news-source-card strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .news-source-card small {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .news-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .news-group {
      display: grid;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.52);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.14);
    }

    .news-group h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 15px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .news-group h3 span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .news-item {
      display: block;
      padding: 13px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      text-decoration: none;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
      border: 1px solid rgba(126,166,255,.18);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(126,166,255,.10);
      transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
    }

    .news-item:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-.2deg);
      border-color: rgba(154,113,223,.28);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 28px rgba(126,166,255,.16);
    }

    .news-item strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--blue-900);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .news-summary {
      margin: 7px 0 0;
      color: #66749f;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-weight: 750;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .news-chip {
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(219,231,255,.72);
      color: #5f6f9f;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .news-chip.hot {
      background: rgba(255,213,232,.62);
      color: #8a5f86;
    }


    @container (min-width: 620px) {
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .hero-card { padding: 24px 28px; }
      .quote-cn { font-size: clamp(24px, 4cqw, 34px); }
      .quote-en { max-width: 70%; }
      .form-grid.responsive-pair { grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr; align-items: start; }
      .countdown-list, .mini-list, .task-list, .record-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .health-panel { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .sleep-card { grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, .7fr) minmax(0, 1.7fr) minmax(150px, .9fr); }
      .language-panel { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .job-form-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .travel-form-grid { grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr auto; }
      .reading-form { grid-template-columns: .7fr 1.2fr .9fr 1.1fr auto; }
      .ai-memo-form { grid-template-columns: .7fr 1.25fr auto auto; }
      .news-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .calendar-grid { gap: 8px; }
      .weekday, .day { min-height: 42px; }
    }

    @media (min-width: 760px) {
      body { align-items: start; }
      .phone-shell {
        width: min(96vw, 1040px);
        height: auto;
        min-height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 48px));
        min-height: min(720px, calc(100dvh - 48px));
        max-height: none;
        border-radius: 42px;
      }
      .phone-shell::before {
        width: 78px;
        height: 8px;
        top: 18px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        opacity: .45;
      }
      .app {
        min-height: inherit;
        height: auto;
        grid-template-columns: 124px minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      .side-rail {
        padding: 56px 16px 18px;
        gap: 12px;
      }
      .tab {
        width: 90px;
        min-height: 64px;
        border-radius: 24px;
      }
      .tab-label { font-size: 12px; white-space: normal; }
      .content {
        max-height: none;
        overflow: visible;
        padding: 58px clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px) 34px;
      }
      h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 4vw, 44px); line-height: 1.08; }
      .page.active {
        max-width: 100%;
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1120px) {
      .phone-shell {
        width: min(96vw, 1360px);
        min-height: min(760px, calc(100vh - 56px));
        min-height: min(760px, calc(100dvh - 56px));
      }
      .app {
        grid-template-columns: 168px minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      .side-rail {
        align-items: stretch;
        padding-left: 18px;
        padding-right: 18px;
      }
      .bunny-logo { align-self: center; }
      .tab {
        width: 100%;
        grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr);
        justify-items: start;
        padding: 0 16px;
        min-height: 60px;
      }
      .tab-icon { font-size: 21px; }
      .tab-label { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.2; }
      .tab-badge { right: 9px; }
      .home-layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(360px, .9fr);
        gap: clamp(18px, 2vw, 28px);
        align-items: start;
      }
      .home-main, .home-side, .task-tools, .task-board, .finance-tools, .finance-records { min-width: 0; }
      .task-desktop-layout, .finance-desktop-layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(360px, .9fr) minmax(0, 1.1fr);
        gap: clamp(18px, 2vw, 28px);
        align-items: start;
      }
      .task-list, .record-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .calendar-card { position: static; }
      .stat-card { min-height: 108px; }
      .record-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto auto; }
    }

    @media (min-width: 1400px) {
      .content { padding-left: 48px; padding-right: 48px; }
      .home-layout {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(430px, .8fr);
      }
      .task-desktop-layout, .finance-desktop-layout {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(420px, .82fr) minmax(0, 1.18fr);
      }
      .donut { width: 156px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 620px) {
      .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .job-form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .travel-form-grid, .wishlist-form, .reading-form, .ai-memo-form, .ai-memo-pockets, .news-source-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .sleep-card, .sleep-form-slim { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .sleep-card .period-status { white-space: normal; }
      .primary-btn, .soft-btn { width: 100%; }
      .record-item { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
      .record-item .tag, .record-item .amount { justify-self: end; }
      .countdown-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; }
      .countdown-number { min-width: 52px; }
      .donut-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; justify-items: center; }
      .donut-card > div:last-child { width: 100%; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 460px) {
      body { padding: 0; }
      .phone-shell { width: 100%; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100dvh; border-radius: 0; padding: 0; }
      .phone-shell::before { top: 0; }
      .app { border-radius: 0; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; }
      .side-rail { padding: 44px 8px 12px; gap: 7px; }
      .content { padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px; }
      h1 { font-size: 28px; }
      .sync-pill { padding: 8px 9px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 360px) {
      .app { grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; }
      .side-rail { padding-left: 6px; padding-right: 6px; }
      .tab { width: 50px; min-height: 50px; border-radius: 19px; }
      .tab-icon { font-size: 19px; }
      .tab-label { font-size: 9px; }
      .content { padding: 48px 10px 14px; }
      .stats-grid { gap: 8px; }
      .stat-card { padding: 12px; min-height: 88px; }
      .stat-value { font-size: 27px; }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: .01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
        transition-duration: .01ms !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="phone-shell">
    <main class="app">
      <aside class="side-rail" id="nav"></aside>

      <section class="content">
        <header class="topbar">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow" id="eyebrow">Bunny desk</p>
            <h1 id="pageTitle">首页</h1>
          </div>
          <button class="sync-pill" id="syncToggle" type="button" title="点击切换设备连接状态">
            <span class="sync-dot"></span><span id="syncText">未连接</span>
          </button>
        </header>

        <section class="page active" id="homePage">
          <div class="home-layout">
            <div class="home-main">
              <div class="hero-card">
                <span class="date-chip" id="homeDate">今天</span>
                <p class="quote-cn" id="quoteCn">温柔前进，也很了不起。</p>
                <p class="quote-en" id="quoteEn">Soft steps still move you forward.</p>
              </div>

              <h2 class="section-title">每日计划</h2>
              <div class="stats-grid">
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--blue-200)"><span class="stat-label">今日任务</span><strong class="stat-value" id="totalTasks">0</strong></article>
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--purple-300)"><span class="stat-label">已完成</span><strong class="stat-value" id="doneTasks">0</strong></article>
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--pink-300)"><span class="stat-label">待完成</span><strong class="stat-value" id="todoTasks">0</strong></article>
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--cream)"><span class="stat-label">完成率</span><strong class="stat-value" id="rateTasks">0%</strong></article>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="home-side">
              <h2 class="section-title">倒数日</h2>
              <div class="card">
                <form class="form-grid responsive-pair" id="countdownForm">
                  <input id="countdownName" autocomplete="off" placeholder="事件名称：旅行 / 考试 / 项目上线" />
                  <div class="form-row"><input id="countdownDate" type="date" /><button class="primary-btn" type="submit">设置</button></div>
                  <div class="draft-note">输入会自动暂存，关闭后再打开不会丢失。</div>
                </form>
              </div>
              <div class="countdown-list" id="countdownList"></div>

              <h2 class="section-title">今日任务速览</h2>
              <div class="mini-list" id="miniList"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="page" id="taskPage">
          <div class="task-desktop-layout">
            <div class="task-tools">
              <div class="card calendar-card" id="calendarBlock">
                <div class="calendar-head"><strong>今日小日历</strong><span class="calendar-month" id="calendarMonth">本月</span></div>
                <div class="calendar-grid" id="calendarGrid"></div>
              </div>

              <div class="health-panel" id="healthBlock">
                <article class="health-card" style="--health-tint: var(--pink-300)">
                  <h3>经期记录</h3>
                  <p>记录开始日期、周期和经期天数，Jade 会帮你计算当前阶段与预计下次日期。</p>
                  <form class="form-grid responsive-pair" id="periodForm">
                    <input id="periodStart" type="date" aria-label="最近一次经期开始日期" />
                    <div class="form-row">
                      <input id="periodCycle" type="number" min="15" max="60" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="周期天数，如 28" />
                      <input id="periodDays" type="number" min="1" max="15" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="经期天数，如 5" />
                    </div>
                    <button class="soft-btn" type="submit">保存经期</button>
                  </form>
                  <div class="period-status" id="periodStatus">设置最近一次开始日期后显示预测。</div>
                </article>

                <article class="health-card" style="--health-tint: var(--blue-200)">
                  <h3>运动健身</h3>
                  <p>记录今天的运动，比如：瑜伽 20分钟、跑步 3公里、力量训练 30分钟。</p>
                  <form class="form-row" id="exerciseForm">
                    <input id="exerciseInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="例如：瑜伽 20分钟" />
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">打卡</button>
                  </form>
                  <div class="draft-note">运动记录会自动保存在本地。</div>
                </article>

                <article class="health-card sleep-card" style="--health-tint: var(--purple-300)">
                  <div>
                    <h3>睡眠记录</h3>
                    <p>只记录睡觉时间和起床时间，轻轻保存昨晚的休息。</p>
                  </div>
                  <form class="sleep-form-slim" id="sleepForm">
                    <input id="sleepBedTime" type="time" aria-label="睡觉时间" />
                    <input id="sleepWakeTime" type="time" aria-label="起床时间" />
                    <button class="soft-btn" type="submit">记录睡眠</button>
                  </form>
                  <div class="period-status" id="sleepStatus">记录后会显示最近一次睡眠。</div>
                </article>
              </div>

              <div class="language-panel" id="languageBlock">
                <article class="language-card" data-mark="EN">
                  <h3>英语</h3>
                  <p>单词、听力、口语或英文日记，都可以作为今天的小练习。</p>
                  <div class="language-streak"><strong id="streakEnglish">0</strong><span>天打卡</span><button type="button" data-streak="英语">今日打卡</button></div>
                  <form class="form-row language-form" data-lang="英语">
                    <input id="englishInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="例如：听 15 分钟英文播客" />
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">加入</button>
                  </form>
                </article>
                <article class="language-card" data-mark="粤">
                  <h3>粤语</h3>
                  <p>记录发音、日常表达、影视跟读，让粤语慢慢变熟悉。</p>
                  <div class="language-streak"><strong id="streakCantonese">0</strong><span>天打卡</span><button type="button" data-streak="粤语">今日打卡</button></div>
                  <form class="form-row language-form" data-lang="粤语">
                    <input id="cantoneseInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="例如：练 5 句日常粤语" />
                    <button class="soft-btn" type="submit">加入</button>
                  </form>
                </article>
                <article class="language-card" data-mark="FR">
                  <h3>法语</h3>
                  <p>记录单词、语法、听读或跟读练习，保持轻盈进步。</p>
                  <div class="language-streak"><strong id="streakFrench">0</strong><span>天打卡</span><button type="button" data-streak="法语">今日打卡</button></div>
                  <form class="form-row language-form" data-lang="法语">
                    <input id="frenchInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="例如：背 10 个法语单词" />
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">加入</button>
                  </form>
                </article>
              </div>


              <div class="news-panel" id="newsBlock">
                <article class="news-card">
                  <div class="news-head">
                    <div>
                      <h3>新闻剪贴本</h3>
                      <p>同步 NewsNow 的腾讯新闻综合早报与华尔街见闻快讯，打开或刷新页面时自动拉取最新内容。</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="news-actions">
                      <button class="soft-btn" id="newsRefreshBtn" type="button">刷新新闻</button>
                      <a class="soft-btn" href="https://newsnow.busiyi.world" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">打开 NewsNow</a>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </article>
                <div class="news-source-grid">
                  <article class="news-source-card"><strong>腾讯新闻</strong><small>综合早报 · 热点新闻，点击条目跳转腾讯新闻详情。</small></article>
                  <article class="news-source-card"><strong>华尔街见闻</strong><small>财经快讯 · 实时滚动，点击条目跳转华尔街见闻详情。</small></article>
                </div>
              </div>


              <div class="ai-panel" id="aiBlock">
                <article class="ai-memo-card">
                  <div class="ai-memo-head"><h3>AI 备忘录</h3><span>工具 · 项目</span></div>
                  <form class="ai-memo-form" id="aiMemoForm">
                    <select id="aiMemoType" aria-label="备忘类型">
                      <option value="工具">工具</option>
                      <option value="项目">项目</option>
                    </select>
                    <input id="aiMemoInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="说出或输入：工具名 / 项目想法 / Prompt 灵感" />
                    <button class="soft-btn" id="aiVoiceBtn" type="button">兔兔听写</button>
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">记录</button>
                  </form>
                  <p class="ai-memo-helper">把好用的 AI 工具、项目灵感和消息记录收进两个小口袋，关闭后也会留在本地。</p>
                </article>
                <div class="ai-memo-pockets">
                  <article class="ai-pocket"><strong>工具口袋</strong><small>收藏模型、插件、网站、Prompt 和好用工作流。</small></article>
                  <article class="ai-pocket"><strong>项目口袋</strong><small>记录项目想法、待验证需求和今天的 AI 协作过程。</small></article>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="job-panel" id="jobBlock">
                <article class="job-note">
                  <h3>求职记事本</h3>
                  <p>记录每一次投递：公司、岗位、投递日期和当前进展都会自动保存在本地。</p>
                  <form class="job-form" id="jobForm">
                    <div class="job-form-grid">
                      <input id="jobCompany" autocomplete="off" placeholder="公司" />
                      <input id="jobRole" autocomplete="off" placeholder="岗位" />
                      <input id="jobDate" type="date" />
                      <input id="jobStatus" autocomplete="off" placeholder="进展：已投递 / 面试中 / Offer" />
                    </div>
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">记录投递</button>
                  </form>
                </article>
              </div>

              <div class="reading-panel" id="readingBlock">
                <article class="reading-card">
                  <div class="reading-head"><h3>阅读记录</h3><span>书籍 · 电影</span></div>
                  <form class="reading-form" id="readingForm">
                    <select id="readingType" aria-label="类型">
                      <option value="书籍">书籍</option>
                      <option value="电影">电影</option>
                    </select>
                    <input id="readingTitle" autocomplete="off" placeholder="名称，例如：小王子 / 千与千寻" />
                    <input id="readingDate" type="date" />
                    <input id="readingNote" autocomplete="off" placeholder="一句感想，可不填" />
                    <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">记录</button>
                  </form>
                </article>
              </div>

              <div class="card" id="taskInputCard">
                <form class="form-row" id="taskForm">
                  <input id="taskInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="添加一件小任务" />
                  <button class="primary-btn" type="submit">添加</button>
                </form>
                <div class="draft-note">草稿和任务都会自动保存在本地。</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="task-board">
              <div class="progress-wrap"><div class="progress-line"><span id="progressBar"></span></div><span class="progress-text" id="progressText">0/0</span></div>
              <div class="task-list" id="taskList"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="page" id="financePage">
          <div class="finance-desktop-layout">
            <div class="finance-tools">
              <div class="card">
                <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-top:0">记账理财</h2>
                <p style="margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.45">输入或语音说「项目 + 花费」，例如：奶茶 18、地铁 6.5，Jade 会自动分类。</p>
                <form class="form-grid" id="financeForm">
                  <input id="financeInput" autocomplete="off" placeholder="例如：咖啡 28" />
                  <div class="form-row"><button class="soft-btn" id="voiceBtn" type="button">兔兔听写</button><button class="primary-btn" type="submit">记一笔</button></div>
                  <div class="draft-note">账单自动保存在本地；设备未连接时不会跨设备同步。</div>
                </form>
              </div>

              <div class="card donut-card">
                <div class="donut" id="categoryDonut"><div class="donut-total" id="donutTotal">¥0<small>分类占比</small></div></div>
                <div>
                  <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-top:0">支出分类占比</h2>
                  <div class="legend-list" id="categoryLegend"><div class="chart-empty">记一笔账后，这里会生成环形图。</div></div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="stats-grid">
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--pink-300)"><span class="stat-label">今日花费</span><strong class="stat-value" id="todaySpend">¥0</strong></article>
                <article class="stat-card" style="--tint: var(--purple-300)"><span class="stat-label">本月花费</span><strong class="stat-value" id="monthSpend">¥0</strong></article>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="finance-records">
              <h2 class="section-title">账单记录</h2>
              <div class="record-list" id="recordList"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>
    </main>
  </div>

  <script>
    const defaultSections = [
      { id: 'today', name: '今日待办', icon: '✅', tasks: ['晨间整理今日三件事', '处理重要消息', '晚间 5 分钟复盘'] },
      { id: 'health', name: '健康打卡', icon: '🌸', tasks: ['喝满 8 杯水', '经期记录 · 设置最近一次开始日期', '运动健身 · 拉伸 10 分钟', '睡眠记录 · 记录昨晚睡眠'] },
      { id: 'language', name: '语言学习', icon: '🌍', tasks: ['英语 · 背 20 个单词', '粤语 · 练 5 句日常表达', '法语 · 背 10 个法语单词'] },
      { id: 'ai', name: 'AI工具', icon: '🤖', tasks: [] },
      { id: 'news', name: '新闻', icon: '📰', tasks: [] },
      { id: 'job', name: '求职', icon: '💼', tasks: [] },
      { id: 'reading', name: '阅读', icon: '📚', tasks: [] }
    ];

    const motivation = [
      ['温柔前进，也很了不起。', 'Soft steps still move you forward.'],
      ['像小兔子一样轻盈，但目标很坚定。', 'Move lightly like a bunny, stay steady with your goal.'],
      ['今天先完成一小步，明天会感谢你。', 'Finish one small step today; tomorrow will thank you.'],
      ['不用很完美，只要继续靠近想要的生活。', 'You do not need perfect; just keep moving closer.'],
      ['把能量留给重要的事。', 'Save your energy for what matters.'],
      ['慢一点也没关系，你一直在变好。', 'It is okay to be slow; you are still growing.'],
      ['今天也请好好照顾自己。', 'Please take good care of yourself today, too.']
    ];

    const key = 'jade-bunny-workbench-v1';
    const old = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('jade-workbench-v2') || 'null');
    let state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || 'null') || {
      active: 'home',
      connected: false,
      sections: old?.sections || defaultSections.map(s => ({...s, tasks: s.tasks.map((title, i) => ({ id: `${s.id}-${Date.now()}-${i}`, title, done: false }))})),
      countdowns: old?.countdowns || [],
      financeRecords: old?.financeRecords || [],
      period: old?.period || null,
      drafts: {}
    };
    if (!state.drafts) state.drafts = {};
    if (!state.financeRecords) state.financeRecords = [];
    if (!state.countdowns) state.countdowns = [];
    if (!state.period) state.period = null;
    if (!state.sleepRecords) state.sleepRecords = [];
    if (!state.jobApplications) state.jobApplications = [];
    if (!state.readingRecords) state.readingRecords = [];
    if (!state.aiMemos) state.aiMemos = [];
    if (!state.languageStreaks) state.languageStreaks = { '英语': 0, '粤语': 0, '法语': 0 };
    ['英语','粤语','法语'].forEach(lang => { if (typeof state.languageStreaks[lang] !== 'number') state.languageStreaks[lang] = 0; });
    if (!state.newsCache) state.newsCache = { items: [], updatedAt: '', error: '', loading: false };

    function makeDefaultSection(section) {
      return {...section, tasks: section.tasks.map((title, i) => ({ id: `${section.id}-${Date.now()}-${i}`, title, done: false }))};
    }

    function normalizeSections() {
      if (state.active === 'travel') state.active = 'home';
      state.sections = state.sections
        .filter(section => section.id !== 'travel')
        .map(section => {
          if (section.id === 'english') return { ...section, id: 'language', name: '语言学习', icon: '🌍' };
          return section;
        });
      defaultSections.forEach(section => {
        if (!state.sections.some(s => s.id === section.id)) state.sections.push(makeDefaultSection(section));
      });
      const language = state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'language');
      if (language) { language.name = '语言学习'; language.icon = '🌍'; }
      const job = state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'job');
      if (job) { job.name = '求职'; job.icon = '💼'; }
      const news = state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'news');
      if (news) { news.name = '新闻'; news.icon = '📰'; }
    }
    normalizeSections();
    save();

    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    const nav = $('nav');
    const pages = { home: $('homePage'), task: $('taskPage'), finance: $('financePage') };
    const pageTitle = $('pageTitle');
    const eyebrow = $('eyebrow');
    const syncToggle = $('syncToggle');
    const syncText = $('syncText');

    function save() { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(state)); }
    function allTasks() { return state.sections.filter(s => !['ai', 'news'].includes(s.id)).flatMap(s => s.tasks.map(t => ({...t, section: s.name, icon: s.icon}))); }
    function activeSection() { return state.sections.find(s => s.id === state.active); }
    function money(v) { return `¥${Number(v || 0).toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/, '')}`; }

    function setDraft(id, value) { state.drafts[id] = value; save(); }
    function restoreDrafts() {
      ['taskInput','financeInput','countdownName','countdownDate','exerciseInput','sleepBedTime','sleepWakeTime','periodStart','periodCycle','periodDays','englishInput','cantoneseInput','frenchInput','jobCompany','jobRole','jobDate','jobStatus','readingType','readingTitle','readingDate','readingNote','aiMemoType','aiMemoInput'].forEach(id => {
        const el = $(id);
        if (el && state.drafts[id]) el.value = state.drafts[id];
        if (el) {
          el.addEventListener('input', () => setDraft(id, el.value));
          el.addEventListener('change', () => setDraft(id, el.value));
        }
      });
    }

    function renderNav() {
      const items = [
        { id: 'home', label: '首页', icon: '🏠', badge: allTasks().filter(t => !t.done).length },
        { id: 'today', label: '待办', icon: '✅', badge: state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'today')?.tasks.filter(t => !t.done).length || 0 },
        { id: 'health', label: '健康', icon: '🌸', badge: state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'health')?.tasks.filter(t => !t.done).length || 0 },
        { id: 'language', label: '语言', icon: '🌍', badge: state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'language')?.tasks.filter(t => !t.done).length || 0 },
        { id: 'ai', label: 'AI', icon: '🤖', badge: state.aiMemos?.length || 0 },
        { id: 'news', label: '新闻', icon: '📰', badge: state.newsCache?.items?.length || 0 },
        { id: 'job', label: '求职', icon: '💼', badge: state.jobApplications?.length || 0 },
        { id: 'reading', label: '阅读', icon: '📚', badge: state.readingRecords?.length || 0 },
        { id: 'finance', label: '记账', icon: '💰', badge: state.financeRecords.length }
      ];

    function renderSync() {
      syncToggle.classList.toggle('connected', state.connected);
      syncText.textContent = state.connected ? '已连接' : '未连接';
      syncToggle.title = state.connected ? '当前为已连接标识；数据仍保存在本地' : '当前为未连接标识；数据仅保存在本地';
    }

    function renderDateAndQuote() {
      const now = new Date();
      const weekdays = ['周日','周一','周二','周三','周四','周五','周六'];
      $('homeDate').textContent = `${now.getMonth() + 1} 月 ${now.getDate()} 日 · ${weekdays[now.getDay()]}`;
      const q = motivation[now.getDay() % motivation.length];
      $('quoteCn').textContent = q[0];
      $('quoteEn').textContent = q[1];
    }

    function daysUntil(dateString) {
      const now = new Date();
      const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
      const target = new Date(dateString + 'T00:00:00');
      return Math.ceil((target - today) / 86400000);
    }

    function renderCountdowns() {
      const list = $('countdownList');
      list.innerHTML = '';
      if (!state.countdowns.length) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><strong>还没有倒数日</strong>设置一个想期待的日期吧。</div>';
        return;
      }
      state.countdowns.forEach(item => {
        const left = daysUntil(item.date);
        const number = left > 0 ? left : Math.abs(left);
        const label = left > 0 ? '天后' : left === 0 ? '今天' : '天前';
        const row = document.createElement('article');
        row.className = 'countdown-item';
        row.innerHTML = `<div><strong></strong><br><small>${item.date}</small></div><div class="countdown-number">${number}<span>${label}</span></div><button class="delete-btn">×</button>`;
        row.querySelector('strong').textContent = item.name;
        row.querySelector('button').onclick = () => { state.countdowns = state.countdowns.filter(x => x.id !== item.id); save(); renderCountdowns(); };
        list.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    $('countdownForm').onsubmit = e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = $('countdownName').value.trim();
      const date = $('countdownDate').value;
      if (!name || !date) return;
      state.countdowns.unshift({ id: `cd-${Date.now()}`, name, date });
      $('countdownName').value = ''; $('countdownDate').value = '';
      state.drafts.countdownName = ''; state.drafts.countdownDate = '';
      save(); renderCountdowns();
    };

    function renderHome() {
      renderDateAndQuote();
      const tasks = allTasks().filter(t => t.section !== '求职');
      const done = tasks.filter(t => t.done).length;
      $('totalTasks').textContent = tasks.length;
      $('doneTasks').textContent = done;
      $('todoTasks').textContent = tasks.length - done;
      $('rateTasks').textContent = tasks.length ? `${Math.round(done / tasks.length * 100)}%` : '0%';
      renderCountdowns();
      const mini = $('miniList'); mini.innerHTML = '';
      const today = tasks.slice(0, 6);
      if (!today.length) mini.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><strong>还没有任务</strong>去左侧分类里添加今天的小目标。</div>';
      today.forEach(t => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'list-item';
        row.innerHTML = `<span>${t.done ? '✓' : t.icon}</span><strong></strong><small>${t.section}</small>`;
        row.querySelector('strong').textContent = t.title;
        mini.appendChild(row);
      });

    function renderCalendar() {
      const now = new Date();
      const year = now.getFullYear(), month = now.getMonth(), today = now.getDate();
      $('calendarMonth').textContent = `${year}年${month + 1}月`;
      const grid = $('calendarGrid'); grid.innerHTML = '';
      ['日','一','二','三','四','五','六'].forEach(d => { const c = document.createElement('div'); c.className = 'weekday'; c.textContent = d; grid.appendChild(c); });
      const first = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
      const prevDays = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
      const days = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
      for (let i = first - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const c = document.createElement('div'); c.className = 'day muted'; c.textContent = prevDays - i; grid.appendChild(c); }
      const hasTask = (state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'today')?.tasks.length || 0) > 0;
      for (let d = 1; d <= days; d++) { const c = document.createElement('div'); c.className = `day ${d === today ? 'today' : ''} ${d === today && hasTask ? 'has-task' : ''}`; c.textContent = d; grid.appendChild(c); }
      const trailing = Math.ceil(grid.children.length / 7) * 7 - grid.children.length;
      for (let d = 1; d <= trailing; d++) { const c = document.createElement('div'); c.className = 'day muted'; c.textContent = d; grid.appendChild(c); }
    }

      const map = { '英语': 'streakEnglish', '粤语': 'streakCantonese', '法语': 'streakFrench' };
      Object.entries(map).forEach(([lang, id]) => {
        const el = $(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = state.languageStreaks?.[lang] || 0;
      });
    }

      $('calendarBlock').style.display = section.id === 'today' ? 'block' : 'none';

      const newsBlock = $('newsBlock');

      const jobBlock = $('jobBlock');

      const readingBlock = $('readingBlock');
      if (readingBlock) readingBlock.style.display = section.id === 'reading' ? 'grid' : 'none';

      const done = section.tasks.filter(t => t.done).length;

      $('progressBar').style.width = section.tasks.length ? `${Math.round(done / section.tasks.length * 100)}%` : '0%';
      if (!section.tasks.length) list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><strong>这一页空空的</strong>添加一个小任务，让 Jade 陪你完成。</div>';
      section.tasks.forEach(task => {

        row.innerHTML = '<button class="check">✓</button><span class="task-text"></span><button class="delete-btn">×</button>';

    const newsSources = [
      { id: 'tencent-hot', name: '腾讯新闻', label: '综合早报', tone: 'hot' },
      { id: 'wallstreetcn-quick', name: '华尔街见闻', label: '快讯', tone: 'quick' }
    ];

    function formatNewsTime(value) {
      if (!value) return '刚刚更新';
      const d = new Date(value);
      if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '已更新';
      return `${d.getMonth() + 1}/${d.getDate()} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }

    function normalizeNewsItem(item, source) {
      return {
        id: `${source.id}-${item.id || item.url || item.title}`,
        sourceId: source.id,
        sourceName: source.name,
        sourceLabel: source.label,
        title: String(item.title || '未命名新闻').replace(/\n+/g, ' ').trim(),
        summary: item.extra?.hover || item.desc || item.summary || '',
        url: item.url || `https://newsnow.busiyi.world/s?id=${source.id}`,
        time: item.extra?.date || item.date || item.updatedTime || '',
        tone: source.tone
      };
    }

    function renderNews() {
      const cache = state.newsCache || { items: [], updatedAt: '', error: '', loading: false };
      const items = cache.items || [];
      const list = $('taskList');
      list.className = 'task-list news-list';
      $('progressText').textContent = cache.loading ? '正在刷新新闻…' : `${items.length} 条新闻`;
      $('progressBar').style.width = cache.loading ? '62%' : (items.length ? '100%' : '0%');
      if (!items.length) {
        const msg = cache.error ? `新闻暂时没有拉取成功：${cache.error}` : '打开新闻板块后，Jade 会从 NewsNow 拉取腾讯新闻和华尔街见闻。';
        list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><strong>${cache.loading ? '正在同步新闻' : '新闻剪贴本还空着'}</strong>${msg}</div>`;
        if (!cache.loading) fetchNews(false);
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = '';
      newsSources.forEach(source => {
        const records = items.filter(item => item.sourceId === source.id).slice(0, 12);
        const group = document.createElement('section');
        group.className = 'news-group';
        group.innerHTML = `<h3>${source.name} · ${source.label}<span>${records.length} 条</span></h3>`;
        if (!records.length) {
          const empty = document.createElement('div');
          empty.className = 'empty';
          empty.innerHTML = `<strong>${source.name}暂无内容</strong>稍后点「刷新新闻」再试试。`;
          group.appendChild(empty);
        }
        records.forEach((record, index) => {
          const link = document.createElement('a');
          link.className = 'news-item';
          link.href = record.url;
          link.target = '_blank';
          link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
          link.innerHTML = '<strong></strong><p class="news-summary"></p><div class="news-meta"><span class="news-chip hot"></span><span class="news-chip"></span><span class="news-chip"></span></div>';
          link.querySelector('strong').textContent = record.title;
          const summary = link.querySelector('.news-summary');
          summary.textContent = record.summary || '点击查看新闻详细内容';
          const chips = link.querySelectorAll('.news-chip');
          chips[0].textContent = record.sourceName;
          chips[1].textContent = record.time ? formatNewsTime(record.time) : `第 ${index + 1} 条`;
          chips[2].textContent = '查看详情 ↗';
          group.appendChild(link);
        });
        list.appendChild(group);
      });
    }

    async function fetchNews(force = true) {
      if (!state.newsCache) state.newsCache = { items: [], updatedAt: '', error: '', loading: false };
      if (state.newsCache.loading) return;
      state.newsCache.loading = true;
      state.newsCache.error = '';
      if (state.active === 'news') renderNews();
      try {
        const results = await Promise.all(newsSources.map(async source => {
          const url = `https://newsnow.busiyi.world/api/s?id=${encodeURIComponent(source.id)}${force ? '&latest' : ''}`;
          const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${source.name} ${res.status}`);
          const data = await res.json();
          return (data.items || []).map(item => normalizeNewsItem(item, source));
        }));
        state.newsCache.items = results.flat();
        state.newsCache.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        state.newsCache.error = '';
      } catch (err) {
        state.newsCache.error = err?.message || '网络请求失败';
      } finally {
        state.newsCache.loading = false;
        save();
        if (state.active === 'news') render();
      }
    }

    $('aiVoiceBtn').onclick = () => {
      const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
      const input = $('aiMemoInput');
      const btn = $('aiVoiceBtn');
      if (!SR) {
        input.placeholder = '当前浏览器不支持语音，可直接输入：工具名 / 项目想法 / Prompt 灵感';
        input.focus();
        return;
      }
      const recognition = new SR();
      recognition.lang = 'zh-CN';
      recognition.interimResults = false;
      recognition.onstart = () => { btn.textContent = '听你说…'; btn.disabled = true; };
      recognition.onresult = e => {
        input.value = e.results[0][0].transcript.replace(/[。.]$/, '');
        setDraft('aiMemoInput', input.value);
      };
      recognition.onend = () => { btn.textContent = '兔兔听写'; btn.disabled = false; input.focus(); };
      recognition.onerror = () => { btn.textContent = '兔兔听写'; btn.disabled = false; input.focus(); };
      recognition.start();
    };
