    function classifyExpense(name) {
      const rules = [
        ['餐饮', ['饭','餐','咖啡','奶茶','外卖','早餐','午餐','晚餐','水果','零食','火锅','烧烤']],
        ['交通', ['地铁','公交','打车','滴滴','高铁','机票','火车','停车','加油']],
        ['学习', ['书','课程','英语','会员','资料','考试','文具']],
        ['购物', ['买','衣服','鞋','包','护肤','化妆','淘宝','京东']],
        ['健康', ['药','医院','体检','健身','瑜伽','运动']],
        ['娱乐', ['电影','游戏','演唱会','旅游','旅行','门票']],
        ['居家', ['房租','水电','物业','家居','清洁','日用']]
      ];
      return rules.find(([_, words]) => words.some(w => name.includes(w)))?.[0] || '其他';
    }

    function parseExpense(text) {
      const match = text.match(/(.+?)[\s，,：:]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)\s*(元|块|rmb|RMB|¥)?$/);
      if (!match) return null;
      const item = match[1].trim();
      const amount = Number(match[2]);
      return item && amount ? { item, amount, category: classifyExpense(item) } : null;
    }

    function renderHealth() {
      if (state.period) {
        $('periodStart').value = state.period.start || '';
        $('periodCycle').value = state.period.cycle || '';
        $('periodDays').value = state.period.days || '';
      }
      const status = $('periodStatus');
      if (!state.period?.start) {
        status.textContent = '设置最近一次开始日期后显示预测。';
        renderSleepStatus();
        return;
      }
      const cycle = Number(state.period.cycle || 28);
      const days = Number(state.period.days || 5);
      const start = new Date(state.period.start + 'T00:00:00');
      const now = new Date();
      const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
      const diff = Math.floor((today - start) / 86400000);
      const dayInCycle = ((diff % cycle) + cycle) % cycle + 1;
      const currentStart = new Date(today);
      currentStart.setDate(today.getDate() - (dayInCycle - 1));
      const nextStart = new Date(currentStart);
      nextStart.setDate(currentStart.getDate() + cycle);
      const nextText = `${nextStart.getMonth() + 1}月${nextStart.getDate()}日`;
      if (dayInCycle <= days) {
        status.textContent = `当前是经期第 ${dayInCycle} 天，预计 ${nextText} 左右进入下次周期。`;
      } else {
        status.textContent = `当前是周期第 ${dayInCycle} 天，距离预计下次经期约 ${cycle - dayInCycle + 1} 天。`;
      }
      renderSleepStatus();
    }

    function sleepDurationText(bedTime, wakeTime) {
      if (!bedTime || !wakeTime) return '';
      const [bh, bm] = bedTime.split(':').map(Number);
      const [wh, wm] = wakeTime.split(':').map(Number);
      if ([bh, bm, wh, wm].some(Number.isNaN)) return '';
      let start = bh * 60 + bm;
      let end = wh * 60 + wm;
      if (end <= start) end += 24 * 60;
      const total = end - start;
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 60);
      const minutes = total % 60;
      return minutes ? `${hours}小时${minutes}分钟` : `${hours}小时`;
    }

    function renderSleepStatus() {
      const status = $('sleepStatus');
      if (!status) return;
      const latest = state.sleepRecords?.[0];
      if (!latest) {
        status.textContent = '记录后会显示最近一次睡眠。';
        return;
      }
      if (latest.bedTime && latest.wakeTime) {
        const duration = latest.duration || sleepDurationText(latest.bedTime, latest.wakeTime);
        status.textContent = `最近一次：${latest.bedTime} 睡 · ${latest.wakeTime} 起${duration ? ` · ${duration}` : ''}`;
        return;
      }
      status.textContent = latest.hours ? `最近一次：${latest.hours} 小时` : '记录后会显示最近一次睡眠。';
    }

    $('periodForm').onsubmit = e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const start = $('periodStart').value;
      const cycle = Number($('periodCycle').value || 28);
      const days = Number($('periodDays').value || 5);
      if (!start) return;
      state.period = { start, cycle, days };
      state.drafts.periodStart = start;
      state.drafts.periodCycle = String(cycle);
      state.drafts.periodDays = String(days);
      save(); renderHealth();
    };

    $('exerciseForm').onsubmit = e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const title = $('exerciseInput').value.trim();
      if (!title) return;
      const health = state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'health');
      health.tasks.unshift({ id: `exercise-${Date.now()}`, title: `运动健身 · ${title}`, done: true });
      $('exerciseInput').value = ''; state.drafts.exerciseInput = '';
      save(); render();
    };


    $('sleepForm').onsubmit = e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const bedTime = $('sleepBedTime').value;
      const wakeTime = $('sleepWakeTime').value;
      if (!bedTime || !wakeTime) return;
      const duration = sleepDurationText(bedTime, wakeTime);
      if (!state.sleepRecords) state.sleepRecords = [];
      state.sleepRecords.unshift({ id: `sleep-${Date.now()}`, bedTime, wakeTime, duration, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      const health = state.sections.find(s => s.id === 'health');
      if (health) health.tasks.unshift({ id: `sleep-task-${Date.now()}`, title: `睡眠记录 · ${bedTime} 睡 / ${wakeTime} 起${duration ? ` · ${duration}` : ''}`, done: true });
      ['sleepBedTime','sleepWakeTime'].forEach(id => { const el = $(id); if (el) el.value = ''; state.drafts[id] = ''; });
      save(); render();
    };

    function renderCategoryChart(records) {
      const donut = $('categoryDonut');
      const totalEl = $('donutTotal');
      const legend = $('categoryLegend');
      const palette = ['#7ea6ff', '#ff8fbd', '#9a71df', '#6dc9b5', '#ffb95f', '#b7c7ff', '#f5a3d0', '#9fb3ff'];
      const byCategory = records.reduce((acc, r) => {
        acc[r.category] = (acc[r.category] || 0) + Number(r.amount || 0);
        return acc;
      }, {});
      const entries = Object.entries(byCategory).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
      const total = entries.reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0);
      totalEl.innerHTML = `${money(total)}<small>分类占比</small>`;
      if (!total) {
        donut.style.setProperty('--segments', 'conic-gradient(var(--blue-200) 0 100%)');
        legend.innerHTML = '<div class="chart-empty">记一笔账后，这里会生成环形图。</div>';
        return;
      }
      let cursor = 0;
      const segments = entries.map(([name, value], index) => {
        const start = cursor;
        const end = cursor + value / total * 100;
        cursor = end;
        return `${palette[index % palette.length]} ${start}% ${end}%`;
      }).join(', ');
      donut.style.setProperty('--segments', `conic-gradient(${segments})`);
      legend.innerHTML = '';
      entries.forEach(([name, value], index) => {
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        row.className = 'legend-row';
        row.innerHTML = `<span class="legend-dot" style="--dot:${palette[index % palette.length]}"></span><span>${name}</span><strong>${Math.round(value / total * 100)}%</strong>`;
        legend.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    $('financeForm').onsubmit = e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const parsed = parseExpense($('financeInput').value.trim());
      if (!parsed) { $('financeInput').placeholder = '没识别到金额，试试：咖啡 28'; return; }
      state.financeRecords.unshift({ id: `fin-${Date.now()}`, ...parsed, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      $('financeInput').value = ''; state.drafts.financeInput = '';
      save(); render();
    };

    $('voiceBtn').onclick = () => {
      const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
      if (!SR) { $('financeInput').placeholder = '当前浏览器不支持语音，可直接输入：咖啡 28'; return; }
      const r = new SR();
      r.lang = 'zh-CN';
      r.interimResults = false;
      r.onstart = () => $('voiceBtn').textContent = '听你说…';
      r.onresult = e => { $('financeInput').value = e.results[0][0].transcript.replace(/。$/, ''); setDraft('financeInput', $('financeInput').value); };
      r.onend = () => $('voiceBtn').textContent = '兔兔听写';
      r.start();
    };

    function sameDay(a, b) { return a.getFullYear() === b.getFullYear() && a.getMonth() === b.getMonth() && a.getDate() === b.getDate(); }
    function renderFinance() {
      const now = new Date();
      const records = state.financeRecords;
      const today = records.filter(r => sameDay(new Date(r.createdAt), now)).reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);
      const month = records.filter(r => { const d = new Date(r.createdAt); return d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear() && d.getMonth() === now.getMonth(); }).reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);
      $('todaySpend').textContent = money(today);
      $('monthSpend').textContent = money(month);
      renderCategoryChart(records);
      const list = $('recordList'); list.innerHTML = '';
      if (!records.length) list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><strong>还没有账单</strong>发送「项目 + 花费」，Jade 会自动分类记录。</div>';
      records.forEach(record => {
        const d = new Date(record.createdAt);
        const row = document.createElement('article');
        row.className = 'record-item';
        row.innerHTML = `<div><strong></strong><br><small>${d.getMonth()+1}/${d.getDate()} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}</small></div><span class="tag">${record.category}</span><span class="amount">${money(record.amount)}</span><button class="delete-btn">×</button>`;
        row.querySelector('strong').textContent = record.item;
        row.querySelector('button').onclick = () => { state.financeRecords = state.financeRecords.filter(r => r.id !== record.id); save(); render(); };
        list.appendChild(row);
      });
    }

    function showPage(kind) {
      Object.values(pages).forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      if (kind === 'finance') pages.finance.classList.add('active');
      else if (kind === 'home') pages.home.classList.add('active');
      else pages.task.classList.add('active');
    }

    function render() {
      renderSync();
      renderNav();
      if (state.active === 'home') {
        showPage('home'); pageTitle.textContent = 'Jadeの工作台'; eyebrow.textContent = 'Bunny desk'; renderHome();
      } else if (state.active === 'finance') {
        showPage('finance'); pageTitle.textContent = '记账理财'; eyebrow.textContent = state.connected ? 'Local data · connected' : 'Local data · offline'; renderFinance();
      } else {
        const s = activeSection();
        showPage('task'); pageTitle.textContent = s.name; eyebrow.textContent = 'Cute planner'; renderTasks();
      }
    }

    restoreDrafts();
    render();
    if (state.active === 'news') fetchNews(false);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
